yt.title: "Lock the door, even if you hear the dog." There is no dog 😨 #scary #horror #shorts
yt.description:
Rule two: lock the back door at nine. Even if you hear the dog.
The owners put the dog down six years ago.

Full story: "If It Knocks From Inside, Don't Open It" on the channel.
🎧 headphones on.

#scarystories #horror #3amstories #housesitting #shorts

lines: Even if you hear the dog.

scenes.text: The house-sitting rules said: lock the back door at nine. Even if you hear the dog.
Five hundred bucks. Three nights. An old farmhouse in the snow. The owners are in Florida.
You look all evening. No bowl. No leash. Not one dog hair on the couch.

msgs: where's the dog? want him inside before i lock up
We put Duke down six years ago.

scenes.text: So you text the owner. Where's the dog? Four seconds later. We put Duke down six years ago. Lock the door.
You turn the deadbolt. And something on the other side starts scratching. Low. Right at the bottom of the door.
Wait. If there's no dog... what's it scratching for? Then a voice, right against the wood.

msgs: Beach day! Florida is so warm 🌴

scenes.text: You see, it doesn't need to break in. It just needs a voice you trust, so you turn the lock yourself.
Because that was Mrs. Pruitt's voice. And Mrs. Pruitt is in Florida.
